resources.string: When you switch apps, Zlip becomes a small window and the cover stays on. Tap the window to return; closing it turns the cover off.
If neither screen is touched for this long while Zlip is open, the cover turns off. The inner screen warns 15 s before; a touch keeps it on.
Mirror screen: Android asks to record or cast; tap Start. Zlip records nothing.
Your screen is on the cover until you leave Zlip. Protected apps show black.
Your screen is on the cover. Protected apps show black.
Mirroring could not start. Try again.
Mirroring starts in this view. Whole screen shows all of it with black bars; Fill fills the cover and you swipe to see the rest.
On the cover: double-tap, then swipe to move around and pinch with two fingers to zoom. A tap switches between Whole screen and Fill.
Protected apps show black, Android asks for permission every time, and mirroring uses more battery.
Shown while your screen is mirrored to the cover, with a button to stop.
Mirroring your screen to the cover
The picture never leaves your phone and is not recorded.
